lives in §01 only). Any scroll-linked motion here stays inside this section; with
, show all three steps in document order with no autoplay.
Three equal columns + founder band + voice quote. Same as
We acquire vertical software and make it run better. Primary lens: investors.
Buy and keep buying; not shelve.
AI + payments + back office. Link → Our Advantage.
Intent: a home, not an exit.
One genericized quote [placeholder — client to confirm].
Left column scrolls three blocks; right column holds a sticky photo + caption that cross-fades per block. No video; schematic only.
Intent: narrative scroll + one visual anchor.
↓ user scrolls; rail stays pinned until section ends
Photo slot — swaps with active step
. Stats pulled out of body copy (revision 2026-10-16).
Option 3 — Tabbed (one panel at a time)
Addresses Figma “more dynamic” without scroll-jacking. Acquire · Grow · Lead as tabs; one metric block + one image per state.
Keyboard: arrow keys between tabs; photo updates with selection.
Figma comment addressed: more dynamic information sharing without long pinned scroll.
Three cards in a row; one expands inline to show metric + body + image. Mobile: stack.
Intent: compare the three moves at a glance.
Intent: buy vertical software and keep it running.
Founder CTA band can sit below accordion (same as option 1).
Figma comment addressed: dynamic layout alternative; only one expanded panel carries detail at a time.
Unusual directions for review. Each includes a motion spec (duration, trigger, reduced-
motion fallback). None are implemented in homev2; they are ideas to react to before any
One horizontal “deal timeline.” Drag the playhead or scroll within the section to scrub Acquire → Grow → Lead; copy + photo cross-fade at stops.
Intent: investor deck as an interactive strip.
↔ scrub · active stop drives headline + image above the track (not shown)
Pointer drag on playhead, or section-local scroll (not full-page pin).
Playhead snaps to 3 stops; 200–300ms cross-fade on text/photo; optional tick haptic on stop (mobile off).
Three stops as vertical stack; playhead hidden; all copy visible.
Feels like a second “hero pin” if tied to viewport — keep mapping to section height only.
Three story cards stacked. Each scroll “tick” or swipe deals the top card away; next Acquire/Grow/Lead card fans in. Metaphor: pipeline of acquisitions.
Intent: category leader in its vertical.
Intent: payments + AI behind the product.
Intent: we keep buying — card deals forward on interaction.
Order can reverse (deal from Acquire → Lead) so the story reads forward as cards leave.
Wheel within section (threshold), or horizontal swipe on mobile.
Top card: translate X + rotate 8–12°, 400ms ease-out; stack compresses upward; max 3 deals then section releases.
Same three cards listed; optional “Show next” button instead of swipe.
Playful, founder-friendly; may read too casual for sovereign-wealth lens — test with investors first.
Center = “Vertical software portfolio”; three outer nodes = Acquire / Grow / Lead. Hover or auto-cycle brings one node forward; center copy updates. Not the Axis B headline “growth engine.”
Avoid literal “platform” or OS language in center label (KB / client vocab).
Hover (desktop) or 5s auto-rotate with pause on focus/hover.
Active node scales 1.05, center cross-fades metric; subtle dashed orbit rotation 60s loop (optional, off by default).
Static triangle diagram; three paragraphs below hub, no rotation.
Diagram-heavy; needs alt text / list duplicate for screen readers.
Option 8 — Single metric stage + slow marquee
One oversized number morphs (70,000+ → $75B+ → 2,000+) while a slow horizontal marquee underneath carries the three narratives; hover pauses marquee (Square-style drift).
Marquee autoplays (CSS loop); big number advances when each panel hits center (IntersectionObserver) or every 4s.
Number: count-up or cross-fade 500ms; marquee 18s linear (lab preview animates — production must respect reduced motion).
Marquee becomes 3-column grid; all metrics listed; no count-up.
Scale-first (investor KPI) without a third pinned hero; pairs with “narrative first, data second” when copy leads the stage label.
Each step’s body copy “types in” as its block enters the viewport; metric appears last with a cursor blink.
Embedded fintech and operational advantages layered on top
IntersectionObserver per block; type runs once per visit (sessionStorage optional).
Char reveal 20–35ms/char; metric fade-in after line completes; no loop.
Full copy visible immediately; hide cursor.
Human, editorial; slow readers may feel rushed — cap line length.
Shaft UI: scroll “rides” from floor A1 (Acquire) → G2 (Grow) → L3 (Lead); door panel shows that floor’s story.
Intent: what changes is what’s behind the software.
Section scroll progress maps to floor index; snap at thirds.
Floor highlight 150ms; door content cross-fade 250ms; subtle “ding” optional (muted default).
Three floors listed with static copy beside shaft diagram.
Gimmick unless copy is strong; elevator metaphor ≠ “exit.”
Full-bleed photo for step N; vertical wipe reveals step N+1 (film transition). Text stays in safe zone left.
↔ wipe edge moves with scroll · photo fills behind both halves
Scroll through 3 “acts” inside section (~300vh total max).
clip-path inset or translateX wipe; per-frame writes, no CSS transition on scroll (KB §23.6 spirit).
Three stacked full-width bands, no wipe.
Cinematic; ties to video-hero language without reusing opening pin.
Eleven faint “vertical” stars; a bright path connects three that tell Acquire → Grow → Lead. Rest stay context only.
Links beat 02 to 11 verticals without repeating homepage filmstrip tiles (Axis A rule).
Path draws on scroll (stroke-dashoffset) or on hover of each bright node.
800ms path draw; node pulse once when active; copy panel below updates.
Static diagram + numbered list of three steps.
Abstract; investors may want literal stats adjacent.
Back-office metaphor: receipt/ledger prints three line items (Acquire, Grow, Lead) as user scrolls; paper roll animates upward.
Each third of section scroll adds a line; haptic tick optional.
translateY roll 300ms; monospace only — matches Fragment Mono voice.
All lines visible; no roll animation.
Payments/back-office nod without leading with payments (KB message order).
Three text planes at different scroll speeds (foreground Lead, mid Grow, back Acquire) — depth implies time / scale.
Per-frame transform only; disable on mobile if janky.
Can disorient; keep one focal headline visible at all times.
Radar UI cycles; each “blip” is Acquire / Grow / Lead. When sweep hits blip, side panel shows metric + one line.
Panel swap when sweep within 15° of blip; pause on focus.
Static radar diagram + three text blocks.
“Scanning markets” — investor scale; avoid military/aggressive art.
Stack grows upward: base = Acquire, middle = Grow (payments/AI), top = Lead. Each scroll step “places” a tier with a thud micro-motion.
Scroll thirds or “Add layer” button for reduced-motion parity.
scaleY 0→1 from bottom, 400ms ease-out; new tier highlighted one beat.
Full stack shown; labels beside diagram.
Opposite of hero “grow morph” — builds model don’t inflate hero again.
Schematic map; pins drop on scroll for offices / verticals / scale — copy beside map ties to Acquire → Grow → Lead.
Use inferable geography only; no confidential site list until client approves.
One pin per scroll third; optional count-up beside map.
drop + bounce 500ms; cluster pins at high zoom only on desktop.
Map static; pins visible; list format duplicate.
US/Canada reach (client review theme) without a literal geo product.
Airport-style flaps cycle ACQ → GRW → LED (or full words); below, one paragraph + metric syncs to displayed flap.
Auto cycle 2.5s or scroll-snapped index; click flap to jump (keyboard 1–3).
Flap rotateX half-flip 200ms (or opacity swap if 3D costly); sync metric cross-fade.
Show “Acquire · Grow · Lead” as plain heading row; all metrics listed.
Transportation vertical nod without literal vehicle creative.
